verification_method.imports: Python standard library only: hashlib, json, re, pathlib
verification_method.execution: Document checker executed as a temporary -c script; no application imports, pytest, inference or installation.
verification_method.script_source: import hashlib, json, re from pathlib import Path root=Path.cwd() path=root/"docs/planejamento/modulo-05-saidas-revisoes.md" raw=path.read_bytes() doc=raw.decode("utf-8",errors="strict") lines=doc.splitlines() checks=[] def add(name,ok,detail=None): checks.append({"check":name,"passed":bool(ok),"detail":detail}) add("utf8_strict",True) add("no_replacement_or_nul","\ufffd" not in doc and "\x00" not in doc) fence=None noncode=[] for no,line in enumerate(lines,1): m=re.match(r"^\s*(\x60{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$",line) if m: delim=m.group(1) if fence is None: fence=(delim[0],len(delim),no) elif delim[0]==fence[0] and len(delim)>=fence[1]: fence=None noncode.append("") else: noncode.append(line if fence is None else "") add("fences_balanced",fence is None,fence) body="\n".join(noncode) anchors=re.findall(r'',doc) add("anchors_unique",len(anchors)==len(set(anchors)),len(anchors)) local=[]; external=[]; errors=[] for label,target in re.findall(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)',body): if target.startswith(("https://","http://")): external.append(target); continue filepart,sep,anchor=target.partition("#") dest=(path.parent/filepart).resolve() if filepart else path if not dest.exists(): if filepart=="apoios-modulo-05/verificacao-documental.json": local.append({"target":target,"reserved_report":True}); continue errors.append("missing:"+target); continue if anchor: targetdoc=dest.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig") explicit=re.findall(r'',targetdoc) if anchor not in explicit: errors.append("anchor:"+target) local.append({"target":target}) add("local_links_and_anchors",not errors,errors) table_errors=[]; table_count=0; i=0 while i1 and not re.fullmatch(r'\|[\s|:\-]+\|',noncode[start+1]): table_errors.append(("separator",start+2)) else:i+=1 add("markdown_tables",not table_errors,{"tables":table_count,"errors":table_errors}) decisions=re.findall(r'^\| (D5-\d{2}) \|',body,re.M) tasks=re.findall(r'^### (M5-\d{2}) — ',body,re.M) tests=re.findall(r'^\| (T5-\d{2}) \|',body,re.M) expected_d={f"D5-{i:02}" for i in range(1,41)} expected_m={f"M5-{i:02}" for i in range(1,21)} expected_t={f"T5-{i:02}" for i in range(1,61)} add("decisions_40_defined_and_40_covered",set(decisions)==expected_d and len(decisions)==80,{i:decisions.count(i) for i in sorted(expected_d)}) add("tasks_20_unique",set(tasks)==expected_m and len(tasks)==20) add("tests_60_unique",set(tests)==expected_t and len(tests)==60) for pref,allowed in [("D5",expected_d),("M5",expected_m),("T5",expected_t)]: unknown=set(re.findall(r"\b"+pref+r"-\d{2}\b",doc))-allowed add(pref+"_references_resolve",not unknown,sorted(unknown)) coverage=body.split("## 17. Checklist",1)[1].split("### 17.1",1)[0] rows=[x for x in coverage.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\| D5-",x)] coverage_results=[] for row in rows: cells=row.strip("|").split("|") did=cells[0].strip() mrefs=re.findall(r"M5-\d{2}",row);trefs=re.findall(r"T5-\d{2}",row) ok=bool(mrefs and trefs and re.search(r"\]\(#m5-",row)) coverage_results.append({"decision":did,"passed":ok,"tasks":mrefs,"cases":trefs}) add("individual_decision_coverage",len(coverage_results)==40 and all(x["passed"] for x in coverage_results)) task_errors=[] sections=re.split(r"(?m)^### (M5-\d{2}) — ",doc) for j in range(1,len(sections),2): tid,content=sections[j],sections[j+1] content=content.split('
